description: This Java class 'ConceptSaveHandler' is responsible for processing 'Concept' objects when they are saved within the OpenMRS framework. It ensures that related entities such as names, descriptions, concept sets, answers, and mappings are properly linked to the main concept during save operations.

classes.name: ConceptSaveHandler
classes.description: Handles the saving process of 'Concept' objects by setting appropriate references between the concept and its related entities during save operations.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a Concept object, setting references for its names, concept sets, answers, descriptions, and concept mappings, ensuring proper linkage before persistence.
